---
title: "📦 ae03-data-wrangling"
subtitle: "Importing, cleaning, exploring and correlating data"
---

An RStudio project with four exercises and the five datasets they use. Covers
[data wrangling](../topics/10-data-wrangling.qmd) and
[describing data](../topics/20-data-description.qmd).

```{=html}
<p><a class="mp-download" href="/ae/ae03-data-wrangling.zip" download>⬇ Download ae03-data-wrangling.zip</a></p>
```

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
Unzip it, then open `ae03-data-wrangling.Rproj` in RStudio. Every path inside
the exercises is relative to that project, so the data will load without edits.
:::
